title: BookBuddy Dependency CVE Triage Registry
description: Tracks accepted Moderate-severity vulnerabilities with architectural rationale, mitigating controls, and review expiration dates. High and Critical severities are strictly prohibited.

triagedAdvisories.rationale: Artillery is a standalone load test CLI runner executed exclusively in synthetic staging/benchmarks, not bundled into production runtime or serverless endpoints.
Autocannon is a developer benchmark harness for HTTP throughput testing, isolated from user inputs and production traffic.
Vitest mocker vulnerability affects local test execution redirect mocking; not shipped in Vite production client bundle.
Transitive OpenTelemetry instrumentation advisory under upstream patch coordination; pinned to LTS instrumentation.
Log forging via unescaped Unicode line separators in Morgan; BookBuddy wraps logs through Winston and sanitizes request headers and parameters prior to logging.
Express query parsing limit bypass; BookBuddy applies strict Zod contract schema validation (validate middleware) with exact shape requirements before query parameters reach controllers.
